replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
Hello Zombie_tate

You were banned by me and so here is the evidence:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QSjWq-QKiMY&feature=youtu.be
As you can see you took no KB at all. Even if you were lagging there would of been a time to get at least a little KB from it. I watched you and there was no KB. Even if you were lagging really bad there should of been some way to get 
https://youtu.be/DuztuPbxTNw?t=1m50s
This video a great example of lag with Kb. The person in the video took less Kb and even delayed Kb near the end. Where in my video there was no Kb at all.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

During the video, it didn't seem like you were lagging at all, compared to other parts in the clip and nor was the knockback delayed. You did not take any knockback whatsoever while in that fight. So therefore, you were using Anti KB. 

You may create another appeal regarding this issue in 6-8 months as it is currently denied.

Regards,
Fouled,
Avicus Senior Moderator.
